get.description: Executes a comprehensive retrieval of the account entity identified by the provided `accountId`. This endpoint returns the `AccountDeepModel`, which includes nested structures for user profile data, associated preferences, security settings, and historical activity logs. Access to this resource is strictly controlled via the `X-Session-Token` header. Additionally, the `X-Audit-Mode` header can be utilized to trigger verbose logging of this read operation for compliance and security auditing purposes.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: The unique, immutable Universally Unique Identifier (UUID) of the account to be retrieved. This ID must correspond to an existing record in the primary database.

parameters.name: X-Session-Token
parameters.description: A valid, active session token issued by the authentication service. This token is required to validate the identity of the requester and ensure they possess the necessary `account:read` permissions.

parameters.name: X-Audit-Mode
parameters.description: Optional boolean flag. When set to `true`, the system records a high-fidelity audit log entry for this specific read operation, including IP address, timestamp, and full request headers. Useful for compliance checks.

200.description: Operation successful. Returns the full `AccountDeepModel` containing all available data points for the requested account.

standardAccount.description: Example of a fully populated account response for an active user.

400.description: Bad Request. The `accountId` format is invalid or headers are malformed.

value.message: The provided accountId is not a valid UUID.

401.description: Unauthorized. The `X-Session-Token` is missing, expired, or invalid.

403.description: Forbidden. The session is valid, but the user lacks permission to view this specific account.

404.description: Not Found. No account exists with the provided `accountId`.

value.message: Account with ID 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000 does not exist.

429.description: Too Many Requests. Rate limit exceeded for account retrieval operations.

Retry-After.description: The number of seconds to wait before making a new request.

500.description: Internal Server Error. An unexpected condition was encountered.
